title: Summa Reditus: A Complete Treatise on Admissible Return Through Collapse
version: Architecture Freeze v1.0 (freeze date 2026-06-10, America/Chicago; 314 pages)

tier_1: Whole-corpus placement as the completed canon-facing treatise-object: Reditus as object, Structura Reditus as field, GCD as foundational theory, Tier-1/Tier-0/Tier-2 as authority architecture, UMCP/RCFT/ULRC as functional systems, Tier-2 closures as domain-ingress pathways.

Completed-treatise status: later corrected, expanded, compressed, typeset, archived, or newly deposited editions are declared versions of the same treatise-object unless they announce a new object, contract, or publication role.
tier_0: Order of burden for every evaluative movement: object and contract before canon read; canon read before closure; closure before ledger reconciliation; ledger reconciliation before stance.

source_role: Completed canon-facing treatise; whole-corpus placement and completed-treatise status (handoff manifest; Summa publication record).
scope: Gathers and places the Structura Reditus corpus in one ordered body: object, field, theory, authority architecture, functional systems, operational protocol, case range, recursive lineage, publication architecture, and teaching route.
non_goal: Does not replace the source works, casepacks, closures, protocols, diagrams, teaching materials, language works, critique works, or technical artifacts that made the corpus possible; source works keep their own titles, dates, DOIs, and local burdens unless explicitly incorporated. Prose explanation does not redefine executable protocol, and executable protocol does not redefine the Tier-1 kernel. Architectural completion does not replace local proof.
notes: Publication record: DOI-bearing publication-ready canon-facing architecture freeze. The treatise is source-only in the Tier-2 registry (no SR-OBJ).
